research: The 1517 June 4 sale regest is consolidated in data/documents/1510_4.json; the 1537 June 25 transfer regest is consolidated in data/documents/1537-06-25.json. Other Üttingshof regesta were subsequently split into dated entries.

entries.german: Erwerb des Üttingshofs durch das Spital zu Mgh: Verkauf des halben Hofs an Hans Schütz, Bürger zu Mgh, durch Beringer Reich von Mergentheim, Ritter, dessen Sohn Fritz Reich, Albrecht von Finsterlohr und dessen Ehefrau Margarethe Reich, 1408 [März 10; Regest].
entries.english: Acquisition of the Üttingshof by the hospital at Mergentheim: sale of half the estate to Hans Schütz, citizen of Mergentheim, by Beringer Reich von Mergentheim, Ritter, his son Fritz Reich, Albrecht von Finsterlohr, and Albrecht’s wife Margarethe Reich, 1408 [March 10; regest].
